note: Checked 24 October 2026. All times are GMT: the clocks go back at 02:00 on Sunday 25 October. Still to confirm: Halloween in the City, Co-op Live event times and the Budget statement. TfGM gives no junctions or end date for the Alan Turing Way closure. Co-op Live, Ticketmaster event pages, mancity.com, Manchester City Council and heatonpark.org.uk blocked fetching, so those items use the secondary sources listed. Kick-offs can move for TV.

cards.title: Clocks go back on Sunday
cards.body: British Summer Time ends at 02:00 on Sunday 25 October, when clocks go back one hour to 01:00 GMT. Phones change automatically, but check car, oven, heating and alarm clocks. Every time in this deck is GMT, including United's 14:00 kick-off that afternoon.
cards.mg_alt: Clock face with the hour hand moving back from 2 to 1.

cards.headline: SUN 25 · LAST DAY
cards.title: MCR Monsters turn 10 at Halloween in the City
cards.body: Sunday is the last day of Halloween in the City, CityCo's free family festival across the central retail district. The MCR Monsters mark their 10th birthday with a rooftop monster hunt, Z-arts storytelling, Walk the Plank processions, discos, a monster bake-off and a kids' Halloween hunt. No times are published, so check the event map and FAQs before you go.
cards.mg_alt: Dot-matrix readout of the number 10, for the MCR Monsters' 10th birthday; free, last day Sunday 25 October.

cards.title: Meet Lioness Jill Scott at Central Library
cards.body: Former England captain Jill Scott reads from Match Day Mix-Up! at Central Library on Thursday 29 October, then stays for a meet and greet. The free half-term afternoon also has a Footy Fairy Tales theatre show and medal-making with the National Football Museum, and families can take home a free copy of the book.
cards.mg_alt: Time axis from 10:00 to 18:00 with the 12:00 to 16:00 free drop-in window highlighted.

cards.title: The Budget is on Wednesday
cards.body: Chancellor John Healey delivers the Budget on Wednesday 28 October. The Treasury says it will move money and power out of Westminster and into every postcode around Britain, be built on fiscal discipline and meet the government's fiscal rules. The announcement gives no time for the statement, so check GOV.UK on the day.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Wednesday 28 October marked as Budget day.

cards.title: Event days on Alan Turing Way, one side shut
cards.body: Alan Turing Way has been shut northbound between Ashton Old Road and Grey Mare Lane since 4 April, with diversions in place and no end date. Co-op Live has events on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday, and City host Brighton on Wednesday at 19:30 and Saturday at 15:00, so those two days carry both crowds. Avoid driving: trams still serve Etihad Campus.

span.label: Northbound shut since 4 Apr · no end date

cards.mg_alt: Week strip with event days on Monday 26, Wednesday 28, Thursday 29 and Saturday 31 October, Wednesday and Saturday marked ×2 for a City match plus an arena event, over a bar showing the northbound closure running all week.

cards.title: Final week of the tram shutdown
cards.body: No trams run on the Altrincham, Trafford Centre and Eccles lines until Sunday 1 November, and East Didsbury and Airport trams terminate at Firswood. United host Bournemouth at Old Trafford at 14:00 on Sunday, so take the Trafford Centre shuttle bus to Wharfside. Trams return from first service on Monday 2 November.
cards.mg_alt: Tram diagram: Altrincham, Eccles and Trafford Centre lines closed; the express shuttle calls at Wharfside, nearest the stadium.

cards.title: Heaton Park fireworks return on 7 November
cards.body: Manchester City Council's free fireworks return to Heaton Park on Saturday 7 November, with reduced-noise displays at 17:00 and main displays at 20:00. Entry is free. No funfair is listed for Heaton Park, and no Heaton Park fair falls in this week's dates. Booking details are not published yet, so check nearer the night.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip for 25 October to 1 November with an arrow to Saturday 7 November, displays at 17:00 and 20:00.
